units.name: Boingrot Bounderz
units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

units.notes: Champion: +1 Attack on the champion's weapons.

abilities.name: The Loonking's Entreaty

timing.label: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: you declared The Faces of the Bad Moon

abilities.text: The face of the Bad Moon stays where it is this battle round instead of moving on.

abilities.name: Fangz of da Bad Moon
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18". Roll dice equal to the unmodified casting roll; each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Babbling Wand
abilities.text: Each time a friendly MOONCLAN unit wholly within 12" of Skragrott uses Redeploy, no CP are spent.

abilities.name: Hallucinogenic Fungus Brews
abilities.text: Ward 4+ in round 1, 5+ in round 2, 6+ from round 3.

abilities.name: Gobbapalooza Know-wotz

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

abilities.text:
Roll a dice. On a 3+ pick one (lasts until the start of your next turn):
  • Glareface Dance: a friendly Gitz unit in its combat range adds 1 to run and charge rolls.
  • Nasty Poisons: a friendly Gitz unit in its combat range adds 1 to the Rend of its weapons.
  • Mesmerise: a visible enemy unit within 12" cannot use commands.

abilities.name: Malfunctioning Leystone
abilities.roll: 3 dice, pick one (1 dice with 10+ damage)
abilities.text:
Roll 3 dice (1 dice if Trugg has 10+ damage) and pick one result. Results 2-6 last until the start of your next turn and affect friendly TROGGOTH units wholly within 12" of Trugg:
  • 1 · Shyish: D3 mortal damage on Trugg.
  • 2 · Ghur: +1 Attack on melee weapons.
  • 3 · Aqshy: +1 Rend on melee weapons.
  • 4 · Hysh: Trugg can unbind as if he had WIZARD (1).
  • 5 · Ulgu: −1 to hit for shooting attacks that target them.
  • 6 · Chamon: Trugg has Ward 5+.

abilities.name: Greater Regeneration
abilities.text: Heal (D6) this unit.

abilities.name: Crushing Grip

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Pick an enemy unit within 1". Roll a dice: if it equals or beats the target's Health, 1 model is slain.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.text: While Trugg has 10+ damage points, roll 1 dice instead of 3 for Malfunctioning Leystone.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.text: Heal (D3) this unit.

abilities.name: Magical Resistance

timing.label: Reaction: opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.text: If this unit was picked as a target of that spell, on a 4+ ignore its effect on this unit.

abilities.name: Wade and Smash

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Move 6" but end in combat. Then roll a D3 per enemy unit within 1"; on 2+ inflict that much mortal damage.

abilities.name: Noxious Vomit
abilities.text: An enemy unit allocated damage by Noxious Vomit is drenched in vomit until your next turn: −1 to its save rolls and it ignores positive save modifiers.

abilities.name: Feedin' Time

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

abilities.text:
Pick a friendly SQUIG unit within this unit's combat range and roll a dice. On a 2+ pick one for the rest of the turn:
  • Crimson Deffcap: add 3" to the target's Move.
  • Yellow Lurka: the target's Fang-filled Gobs, Huge Fang-filled Gobs and Massive Fang-filled Gobs gain Crit (Mortal).

abilities.name: Boing! Smash!
abilities.text: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1". Roll a dice per model; each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Squig Rage
abilities.text: While this unit has 10+ damage points, its Huge Fang-filled Gobs have an Attacks characteristic of 6.

abilities.name: Watch Out!
abilities.text: If this unit is destroyed, roll a dice for each enemy unit in its combat range; on a 4+ inflict D3 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Giant Boing!

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

abilities.text: If this unit charged this turn, on a 3+ it can move 3D6" but must end in combat.

abilities.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
abilities.text: If you have no Malevolent Moon on the battlefield, set one up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Lurid Light
abilities.text: Friendly Gloomspite Gitz units wholly within 12" of this manifestation are affected by all four faces of the Bad Moon. Mark them with the "Wholly within 12" of the Malevolent Moon" toggle.

abilities.name: Malevolent Moon: move
abilities.text: The Moon can Normal Move or Run with its 12" Move and FLY. Keep your key units wholly within 12" of it.

abilities.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
abilities.text: If you have no Mushroom on the battlefield, set one up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them. No 9" restriction.

abilities.name: Mutating Spores
abilities.text: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of the Mushroom. For each, roll a dice per model within 6"; each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Summon Scrapskuttle's Arachnacauldron
abilities.text: Set up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Blessings of the Cauldron
abilities.text: Pick a friendly Gitz WIZARD within 1" of the Cauldron: +1 power level until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Summon Scuttletide
abilities.text: Set up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Wall Crawler
abilities.text: This manifestation crosses terrain as if it had FLY.

abilities.name: Endless Terrors
abilities.text: While this manifestation is near a friendly Arachnarok Spider, it has Ward 4+.

abilities.name: Moonclan Lairs

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

abilities.text: Pick a destroyed friendly non-HERO non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE Gitz unit. Set up a replacement with half its models (round up) wholly within 12" of the Loonshrine and more than 3" from enemies.

abilities.name: Bouncing Fury
abilities.text: Each time a friendly SQUIG unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks of its Fang-filled Gobs, Huge Fang-filled Gobs or Massive Fang-filled Gobs for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Loontouched
abilities.text: This HERO gains WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: The Clammy Cowl
abilities.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target the bearer.

abilities.name: Glitzy Bitz Rolla
abilities.text:
Spend 1 rage dice:
  • This unit adds 1 to wound rolls for its attacks for the rest of the turn.
  • If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must raise it by 1 (max 7).

abilities.name: Bad Portents
abilities.text:
Roll a dice:
  • 1-2: nothing happens.
  • 3-5: the Bad Moon moves to the next face.
  • 6: pick any face for this battle round.

abilities.name: Spore Maws
abilities.text: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 12" of the caster. Roll a D3 for each; on a 2+ inflict that much mortal damage.

abilities.name: The Hand of Gork
abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly Gitz unit wholly within 12" of the caster and not in combat (the caster itself is legal: a model is always visible to itself). Remove it and set it up wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Faces of the Bad Moon

timing.label: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round

abilities.text:
Must be used.
  • Round 1: pick the starting face (Grinnin', Scowlin', Sulkin' or Cacklin').
  • Later rounds: the face moves on: Grinnin' → Scowlin' → Sulkin' → Cacklin' → Grinnin'.

abilities.name: Creeping Gloom

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

abilities.text: Pick a terrain feature. Until the start of your next turn, friendly non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE Gitz units wholly within 3" of it are not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.

abilities.name: Frothing Zealots
abilities.text: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN units.

abilities.name: Spiderfang Venom
abilities.text: Combat attacks by friendly SPIDERFANG units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ (Companion weapons included).

abilities.name: Moonlit Hide
abilities.text: Subtract 1 from the Rend of combat attacks that target friendly TROGGOTH units.

abilities.name: Lunar Squigs
abilities.text: Each time a friendly SQUIG unit moves, you may use a value of 4 instead of rolling the dice in its Move characteristic.

abilities.name: Sneaky Snarlfangs
abilities.text: Friendly GITMOB units can use CHARGE and SHOOT abilities even if they used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

mods.value: Can charge and shoot after retreating

abilities.name: Secret Tunnels
abilities.text: If this unit has not been deployed, set it up in reserve in a secret tunnel. It counts as deployed.

abilities.name: 'Neh Neh Na-neh Neh! Can't Catch Me!'

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly MONSTER or BEAST unit. For the rest of the turn it can use CHARGE abilities even after a RUN, but every MOVE it makes must end closer to this unit. The first time it ends a move within this unit's combat range this turn, this unit suffers D6 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Emerge from the Depths
abilities.text: If this unit is in a secret tunnel, set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Deffcap Mushroom

timing.label: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

abilities.text: Add 1 to this unit's power level for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.text: While this unit has 10+ damage points, its Chitinous Legs have an Attacks characteristic of 6.

abilities.name: Catchweb Spidershrine
abilities.text: Friendly SPIDERFANG WIZARDS add 1 to casting rolls while wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Webbing

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Pick an enemy INFANTRY HERO within 1" and roll a dice. On a 3+, it has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Let's Get Bouncin'!

timing.label: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit

abilities.text: Pick a friendly non-HERO MOONCLAN CAVALRY unit in this unit's combat range that has not fought this turn. It can fight immediately after this unit's FIGHT ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Squigs Gone Wild
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack from a unit it was in combat with, roll a dice. On a 5+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal damage after the FIGHT ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Herding Squigs
abilities.text: Roll a dice for each Squig Herder in this unit. For each 2+, return up to D3 slain Cave Squigs to the unit. For each 1, 1 Squig Herder is slain.

abilities.name: Netters
abilities.text: Pick an enemy INFANTRY unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for that unit's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.text: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST.

abilities.name: Hidden Loons
abilities.text: If this unit has not been deployed, set it up in reserve hidden among the mobs. It counts as deployed.

abilities.name: Release the Fanatics!
abilities.text: If this unit is hidden among the mobs, pick a friendly Moonclan Shootas or Moonclan Stabbas unit with 10+ models. Set this unit up wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Puffshroom Frenzy
abilities.text: Other friendly MOONCLAN units add 1 to the Attacks of their melee weapons while wholly within 12" of this unit. Enemy units in combat with this unit subtract 1 from the Attacks of their melee weapons.

abilities.name: A Prod in the Right Direction
abilities.text: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Bite da Moon!

timing.label: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: This unit and every friendly SQUIG unit wholly within 12" of it add 1 to hit rolls for their Fang-filled Gobs, Massive Fang-filled Gobs and Huge Fang-filled Gobs for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ker-splat!

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

abilities.text: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1". Roll a dice for each model in it (max 10). Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Boing! Boing! Boing!
abilities.text: Pick an enemy unit this unit passed across this phase. Roll a dice for each model in this unit that passed across it; each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal damage on that unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.text: While this unit has 10+ damage points, The Dread Mace has 4 Attacks and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilities.text: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not. Instead allocate 6 damage points to it; no ward rolls for those.

abilities.name: Rampaging Destruction

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

abilities.text:
If this unit charged this phase, pick one:
  • Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1". On a 2+, inflict that much mortal damage on it.
  • Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, nothing happens; otherwise inflict mortal damage equal to the two dice multiplied together.

abilities.name: The End of Empires
abilities.text: For the rest of the turn, friendly DESTRUCTION units wholly within 12" of this unit roll 1 extra dice for charge rolls (max 3 dice).

abilities.name: The Shield Inviolate

timing.label: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability

abilities.text: If this unit is the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the spell's effect on this unit. Usable more than once per phase, once per SPELL ability.

abilities.name: Shepherd of Destruction

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Roll a dice. On a 4+, friendly TROGGOTH units add 1 to the Attacks of their melee weapons for the rest of the turn while wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Looncap Mushrooms

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

abilities.text: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly MOONCLAN unit wholly within 12" of it and roll a dice, adding 1 if the Bad Moon is Cacklin'. On a 3+, it has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn. On a 6+, its melee weapons also get +1 Attacks until then.

abilities.name: Gut-Wrenching Stench

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. You may spend up to 3 rage dice: add 1 to the roll for each, and if your opponent's fury level is lower than yours they must raise it by 1 (max 7). On a 5+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Can't Catch Us!

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase

abilities.text: If this unit is not in combat, it can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: I'm da Boss
abilities.text:
Pick a visible friendly Moonclan Stabbas unit wholly within 12" and roll a dice. On a 2+ pick one:
  • Get Back 'Ere!: if it is not in combat, return up to D6 slain models to it.
  • Stab 'Em Good!: it adds 1 to wound rolls for its attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Let's Get Stabbin'!

timing.label: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit

abilities.text: Pick a friendly non-HERO MOONCLAN INFANTRY unit in this unit's combat range that has not fought this turn. It can fight immediately after this unit's FIGHT ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Web Slingshot
abilities.text: Pick a friendly SPIDERFANG unit or a terrain feature within 18" and roll a dice. On a 2+, remove this unit and set it up wholly within 3" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Speed of the Spider God
abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly SPIDERFANG unit wholly within 12". This turn it can RUN and still SHOOT and/or CHARGE.

abilities.name: Flinger
abilities.text: If any Flinger attacks hit, roll a dice after the SHOOT ability. On a 2+, the target is entangled until the start of your next turn: halve its Move.

abilities.name: Beast-binding Webbing

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit, and roll a dice. On a 3+, its Companion weapons get −1 Attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Voracious Predator

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

abilities.text: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 1". Roll a D3 for each; on a 2+ inflict that much mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Realmweb Lurker
abilities.text: If this unit has not been deployed, set it up in reserve skittering through tunnels in reality. It counts as deployed.

abilities.name: Scuttling Terror

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+ it can move 2D6", passing through enemy combat ranges and enemy INFANTRY models, but must end in combat. Then pick an enemy INFANTRY unit it passed across: inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Ambush from Beyond
abilities.text: If this unit is skittering through tunnels in reality, set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Da Frazzlefangz
abilities.text: Enemy units within 6" of this unit subtract 1 from hit rolls for their attacks and cannot use the All-out Attack command.

abilities.name: Rip 'Em ta Bits

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit

abilities.text: Pick a friendly GITMOB unit in this unit's combat range that has not fought this turn. It can fight immediately after this unit's FIGHT ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Time ta Scarper

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a unit wholly within 9" of this unit

abilities.text: Roll a dice. On a 4+, after that FIGHT ability, the fighting unit can move 2D6". It can pass through enemy combat ranges but cannot end in combat.

abilities.name: Vicious Snarls and Great Howls

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: If this unit charged this turn, it and up to 2 friendly GITMOB CAVALRY units in its combat range add 1 to the Attacks of their Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Boss Snarlfang
abilities.text: Friendly GITMOB CAVALRY units add 2 to charge rolls while wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Gimme All da Light
abilities.text: Other friendly GITMOB units (not Frazzlegit Shamans on War-Wheelas) cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Frazzlemist

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

abilities.text: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 9". Roll a D3 for each; on a 2+ inflict that much mortal damage.

abilities.name: Shoddy Wing-like Gizmos

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

abilities.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks this turn, but each re-rolled hit roll gives the Doom Diver −1 Rend for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: I Got Dis, Boss!
abilities.text: While a friendly Snarlboss is within this unit's combat range, this unit and that Snarlboss have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: Careening Destruction

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase

abilities.text: If this unit is in combat, it can move up to its Move, passing through models and enemy combat ranges, but not ending in combat. Then pick up to 1 enemy INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit it passed across: inflict D3 mortal damage plus 1 per model in this unit.

abilities.name: Slice and Soar

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Only if this unit charged this turn. Pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a dice per model in that unit, adding 1 if this unit has 2 models or 2 if it has 3+. Each 6+ inflicts 1 mortal damage. Then you may spend 1 rage dice: this unit moves up to 2D6" (through enemy combat ranges, not ending in combat), and if your opponent's fury level is lower than yours they raise it by 1 (max 7).

abilities.name: Frazzlegit's Flame Stream
abilities.text: This unit can move up to its Move, passing through models and enemy combat ranges, but not ending in combat (usable even in combat). Then pick up to 1 enemy INFANTRY unit it passed across: inflict D6 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Keepin' Up Wiv da Boss

timing.label: Reaction: You declared a  Fight ability for this unit

abilities.text: Pick a friendly Sunsteala Wheelas unit in this unit's combat range that has not fought this turn. It can fight immediately after this unit's FIGHT ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Da Glare of Frazzlegit

timing.label: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase

abilities.text:
For the rest of the turn:
  • Enemy units in combat with any friendly Sunsteala Wheelas subtract 1 from hit rolls.
  • This unit and friendly Sunsteala Wheelas add 6" to their Move.

abilities.name: Markin' Territory
abilities.text: If this unit charged this turn, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Frazzleburned Scrap

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: If this unit charged this turn, it has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Lost in the Horde
abilities.text: If this unit has not been deployed, set it up in reserve lost in the horde. It counts as deployed.

abilities.name: Whirling Destruction

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

abilities.text: If this unit is lost in the horde, set it up wholly within 3" of a friendly Moonclan Stabbas or Shootas unit, then move it 2D6" (it can pass through enemy models and combat ranges and end in combat). Roll a dice for each enemy unit it is in combat with or passed across: inflict that much mortal damage. If it ended in combat, it has charged.

abilities.name: Choking Spore-clouds
abilities.text: Enemy units in combat with this unit subtract 1 from the Attacks of their weapons.

abilities.name: Spinning Loons

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

abilities.text: If this unit was not set up this phase, it can move 2D6". It can pass through enemy combat ranges and end in combat.

abilities.name: Herd Healing
abilities.text: Each time a friendly TROGGOTH unit uses a FIGHT ability, Heal (D3) it after the ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Git and Run
abilities.text: Pick a friendly GITMOB unit in combat. You may pick an enemy unit in combat with it (each enemy unit only once per phase) and roll a D3: on a 2+ inflict that much mortal damage on it. Then the GITMOB unit can move up to its Move through enemy combat ranges, but not ending in combat.

abilities.name: Spreading Loonacy

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

abilities.text: Pick up to 3 friendly units in combat that are non-SQUIG MOONCLAN or SPIDERFANG. For each: make a pile-in move, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict that much mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Extra Snappy

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.text: Pick up to 3 friendly GITMOB units that charged this turn. Their Companion weapons get +1 Rend for the rest of the turn. Mark it on each unit's warscroll.

abilities.name: Grots Upon Grots

timing.label: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

abilities.text: Pick a friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN unit contesting an objective. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to its control score for each of its models that is not contesting any objective.

abilities.name: Backstabber's Blade

timing.label: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

abilities.text: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict that much mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Leering Gitshield
abilities.text: Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack targeting this unit is a 1, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal damage after the ATTACK ability is resolved.

abilities.name: The Clammy Hand
abilities.text: Each time a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the Rally command, you can make 3 extra rally rolls.

abilities.name: Fight Another Day
abilities.text: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately Retreat as if it were your movement phase, suffering no mortal damage.

abilities.name: Fizzcap

timing.label: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase

abilities.text: This unit can use a SUMMON spell from your manifestation lore as if it had WIZARD (1). Its casting roll is an unmodifiable 12 and the spell cannot be unbound. Then, if this unit is not MOONCLAN, roll a dice: on a 1-4, 1 of its models is slain.

abilities.name: Spoofshrooms
abilities.text: Roll a dice (D3+3 if this unit is GITMOB). This unit can move up to that many inches, through enemy combat ranges, but not ending in combat.

abilities.name: Itchy Nuisance
abilities.text: Pick an objective within 18" of the caster. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units contesting it subtract 1 from wound rolls.

abilities.name: Loonshrine Glow
abilities.text: For the rest of the turn, a replacement unit from Moonclan Lairs can be set up wholly within 6" of the caster (and more than 3" from enemies) instead of near the Loonshrine.

abilities.name: Puffballoons
abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ unit wholly within 12" of the caster. Until the start of your next turn, each time an ability inflicts damage on it, afterwards it can move up to 3" (through enemy combat ranges; it can only end in combat with units it was already fighting).

abilities.name: Gitspeed
abilities.text: Until the start of your next turn, friendly non-TROGGOTH GLOOMSPITE GITZ units add 2" to their Move while wholly within 12" of the caster. Mark the cast on the caster's warscroll.

abilities.name: Bright Fright
abilities.text: Pick up to 3 visible friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ units wholly within 12" of the caster. Each can immediately Retreat as if it were your movement phase, suffering no mortal damage.

abilities.name: Gaze of Glareface
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the caster. Until the start of your next turn it cannot RUN and the Range of its ranged weapons is halved.
